snippet.title: The Hunt Begins | Freja Hero Trailer | Overwatch 2
snippet.description:
Next time you want to cross the coldest bounty hunter in the business, think again.

See what happens when Freja’s latest job with Maximilien doesn’t go according to plan in the newest Hero Trailer, ‘The Hunt Begins.’

And play as Freja for a limited time Mar 21-24 before she officially arrives in Season 16.

Overwatch 2 is free to play for everyone on console & PC!
